decisions.reason: The candidate already has a complete same-message MODIFY covering the standalone LDO, activation condition, powered rail, source selection, and standalone-programming support.
Standalone programming through the USB-powered LDO does not change the selected USB-C connector or its sourceability and availability constraints.
The candidate already records the same-message DCDC1 voltage, rating, loads, and normal-operation role; standalone programming does not alter those requirements.
The source decision about standalone USB power does not change the battery-charge status interface; the conditional mention of SK6812 power is not a charge-interface decision.
The standalone USB supply path does not modify the existing battery electrical-protection controller, thresholds, or protection components.
The standalone USB programming arrangement does not change the battery NTC connector, function, or thermal-protection controller.
The power-path explanation does not necessarily change BOM completeness, part-number requirements, or the recorded charge-LED assembly selections.
The candidate already has a same-message MODIFY for the 500 mA rating and identified 5V loads; the standalone 3.3V programming path adds no further change to the switchable boost requirement.

The candidate already records the same-message AXP2101 normal-operation source, battery range, and load coverage; the USB-only programming exception does not invalidate those normal-operation attributes.
Operating the main board without the power board for programming does not change the project's four-board architecture.
The standalone USB power path has no necessary effect on the power board's four-layer stack.
Programming with the power board disconnected does not modify the physical placement, orientation, or accessibility requirements for power-board connectors.
